title: Earthrift
summary: Earthrift is a powerful Blood Spiral spell that sends a powerful wave of energy through the ground similar to Stoneblade however it can hit an enemy just by making contact with its target's shadow.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Earthrift was used by Rassimov against Dante Vale and Lok Lambert. According to Dante Vale the target must watch one's feet to prevent severe injury from this spell. [OAL-084]

Earthrift is also a favored power of Wind who used it to defeat Wilder by targeting his shadow in Klaus' bookshop while hunting down the Amulet of Void. [The Blood Spiral]

Wind later used it in the Phoenix Volcano to stun Dante while fighting to claim the Amulet of Phoenix, once again targeting his shadow this time created by a Boltflare. [The Phoenix's Ashes]
